requiredBehavior: Provision and verify the exact locked Stage-0 revision when the pin changes, while preserving the existing fail-closed check for unmarked trees.
summary: tools/bootstrap.sh rejects a valid new mncs-language.lock.json revision whenever .bootstrap already contains a different marked revision, so the required compiler reference cannot be provisioned without an out-of-band tree move.
title: Bootstrap cannot refresh an existing pinned Stage-0 checkout
